kept.spine: Nothing presses Rundgate at present, and the quiet is not luck. The town is kept ready, and a town kept this ready is not worth the price of trying.
The law is present here and so is the crime, and neither of the two has the run of the town. Nobody here calls the place safe, and nobody calls it dangerous.

kept.poolKey: First-Survey qualification (the reading is a first look)
kept.spine: The safety reading here rests on a first look. What that look took in stands in the reading, and what it missed stands nowhere.
A stranger here is not robbed but told quietly what the arrangement is, and what he is at risk of was arranged well before he arrived.
The hall at Rundgate moves against the criminal factions and the factions move back against the hall, and the town is where the two of them meet.
The town keeps soldiers of its own. The garrison's work is the holding of this place, and the men who do it answer for it as work.
A stranger finds halls here whose business is the kind of trouble a garrison is the wrong answer to. The adventurers' guilds are more than one, and none of them is short of work.

kept.spine: The town keeps stores and is fed by the roads alone. What the grain store buys is the time to do something about a road.
